name: Terrarium 45x35x80
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 45x35x80 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 126.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This 45x35x80 cm terrarium (126 L) is made of quality glass and covered on the outside with film of your choice. The film gives the terrarium a neat look that fits your interior, with wood, bamboo and marble patterns or solid black or white available.

The vertical orientation (80 cm tall) makes this terrarium suitable for arboreal animals, which live in tree canopies and on trunks in the wild. You can add branches, cork and artificial plants to recreate a vertical habitat. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.

You can order this model with a custom film and background. If you need different dimensions or extra equipment (LED lighting, a thermostat, a lock), we build to your specification. Delivery to your address anywhere in Serbia.
